adjudication.rationale: In EventManager.ts updateAllCalendarEvents (refactored to handle multiple calendar references), when a reference has credentialId it sets `credential = this.calendarCredentials.filter(...)[0]` and, if not found, tries `prisma.credential.findUnique(...)` and only reconstructs `credential` if `credentialFromDB && credentialFromDB.app?.slug`. Regardless of whether either lookup succeeds, it then unconditionally executes `result.push(updateEvent(credential, event, bookingRefUid, calenderExternalId));`. If both lookups fail (or DB fetch returns without `app.slug`), `credential` remains undefined and `updateEvent` is invoked with undefined, which can throw and cause the outer try/catch to abort processing of remaining references.
